title: ECBench: Can Multi-modal Foundation Models Understand the Egocentric World? A Holistic Embodied Cognition Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on counter-intuitive and counterfactual scenes (e.g., unexpected spatial relationships, object attributes, or co-occurrences) to test if they hallucinate answers based on prior real-world knowledge rather than relying on actual visual evidence.

Testing models with questions containing missing, erroneous, or ambiguous references to evaluate if they over-rely on or blindly trust the user's prompt instead of grounding their answers in the visual environment.
